repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.summary_zh: public-apis 是一个由社区维护的免费 API 集合库，涵盖地理定位、金融、天气、通信等多个领域，提供即用型 RESTful API 接口，支持 Postman 一键调用，助力开发者快速集成第三方数据服务。
repos.summary_en: The public-apis repository is a community-curated collection of free, ready-to-use REST APIs across diverse domains like geolocation, finance, weather, and communication, enabling developers to quickly integrate third-party data services via Postman.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: ECC 是一个面向 AI 智能体的高性能操作框架，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等主流 AI 编程工具设计。它提供技能管理、本能响应、记忆优化、安全扫描与研究优先的开发模式，支持跨工具统一架构，已在真实产品中经过 10 个月高强度验证。
repos.summary_en: ECC is a high-performance operator system for AI agents, built for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more. It offers skills, instincts, memory optimization, security scanning, and research-first development, with a cross-harness architecture validated through 10+ months of real-world production use.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: Everything Claude Code 是一个专为 AI 智能体性能优化设计的完整系统，涵盖技能、直觉、记忆、安全和研究优先的开发。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cowork 等平台，提供生产级代理、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置，适用于多语言环境，是 Anthropic 黑客马拉松获奖作品。
repos.summary_en: Everything Claude Code is a comprehensive performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, featuring skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, and more, offering production-ready agents, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configurations, evolved over 10+ months of real-world use.

repos.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的月刊，每月28日定期发布，涵盖有趣项目、开源书籍、实战及企业级项目。旨在通过精选优质开源内容，帮助用户快速发现开源魅力，激发学习兴趣，降低入门门槛，从而爱上开源生态。
repos.summary_en: HelloGitHub is a monthly publication that curates and shares interesting, beginner-friendly open-source projects from GitHub. Released on the 28th of each month, it features engaging projects, open-source books, practical tutorials, and enterprise-level codebases to help newcomers discover the joy of open source and build real-world skills quickly.

repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Mem 是专为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，通过 AI 自动捕获、压缩编码开发会话中的关键信息，并在后续会话中智能注入相关上下文，显著提升 AI 编程助手的工作记忆效率与连续性。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system for Claude Code that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant context from coding sessions using AI, enhancing Claude's working memory and session continuity.

repos.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Archify是一款AI代理技能，可将自然语言描述即时转化为可交互的自包含HTML可视化图表，支持架构图、工作流、序列图、数据流等类型，内置动画效果与简洁导出，无缝集成Cursor、Claude Code等主流AI编程工具。
repos.summary_en: Archify is an AI agent skill that instantly converts natural language descriptions into interactive self-contained HTML visualizations, supporting architecture diagrams, workflows, sequence diagrams, and data flows with built-in animations and clean export. It integrates seamlessly with Cursor, Claude Code, and other major AI coding tools.

repos.description: :zap: Dynamically generated stats for your github readmes
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Readme Stats 是一个动态生成 GitHub 统计信息的项目，可自动在个人 README 中展示仓库贡献、语言使用、活跃度等数据，支持高度自定义主题、布局与指标，提升开发者主页展示效果。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Readme Stats dynamically generates GitHub statistics for READMEs, displaying repository contributions, language usage, activity metrics, and more. It supports customizable themes, layouts, and options to enhance developer profile visibility.

repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Claude Skills 是一个精心策划的 Claude AI 技能库，涵盖文档处理、开发工具、数据分析、商业营销等十大领域。通过 Composio 插件，Claude 可连接500+应用执行真实操作（如发邮件、创建工单），实现从文本生成到自动化工作的跨越。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Claude Skills is a curated collection of practical workflows for enhancing Claude AI across platforms. It covers document processing, development tools, data analysis, business automation, and more. With the Composio plugin, Claude can connect to 500+ apps to perform real-world actions like sending emails or creating issues, extending beyond text generation.

repos.description: A list of cool features of Git and GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 GitHub 和 Git 的高级功能速查表，涵盖隐藏特性如忽略空白符、分支对比、行号高亮、任务列表、Emoji 支持、Gist 使用、Hub 工具等，帮助开发者提升工作效率，适用于日常开发协作与代码审查场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a comprehensive cheat sheet of advanced Git and GitHub features, including whitespace ignoring, branch comparisons, line highlighting, task lists, emoji support, Gists, Hub CLI, and more—designed to boost developer productivity in collaborative coding and code review workflows.

repos.description: CLI platform to experiment with codegen. Precursor to: https://lovable.dev
repos.summary_zh: gpt-engineer 是一个基于 CLI 的代码生成实验平台，支持通过自然语言描述需求，由 AI 自动生成并执行代码，并可迭代优化。它支持 OpenAI API、本地模型及 Azure 等多种模型，提供项目创建、代码改进和自定义代理基准测试功能，是早期 AI 编程工具的重要探索。
repos.summary_en: gpt-engineer is a CLI platform for experimenting with AI-driven code generation. It allows users to specify software in natural language, watch an AI write and execute code, and iteratively improve it. Supports OpenAI, local models, and Azure, with features for project creation, code improvement, and benchmarking custom agents.

repos.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Chrome DevTools MCP 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Gemini、Claude、Cursor 等）设计的 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议实现浏览器自动化、性能分析与深度调试。支持网络请求分析、截图、控制台日志追踪及性能追踪，结合 Puppeteer 实现可靠操作，适用于网页自动化与智能调试场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome DevTools MCP is an MCP server enabling AI coding agents (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Cursor) to control and inspect a live Chrome browser via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It provides advanced debugging, performance tracing, network analysis, and screenshot capabilities using Puppeteer for reliable automation, ideal for web automation and intelligent debugging.

repos.description: Opensource IDE For Exploring and Testing API's (lightweight alternative to Postman/Insomnia)
repos.summary_zh: Bruno 是一款开源的 API 探索与测试 IDE，作为 Postman 和 Insomnia 的轻量级替代方案。它采用本地文件系统存储 API 集合，使用 Bru 标记语言描述请求，支持 Git 协作，并坚持离线优先设计，保障用户数据隐私。
repos.summary_en: Bruno is an open-source IDE for exploring and testing APIs, designed as a lightweight alternative to Postman and Insomnia. It stores collections locally using the Bru markup language, supports Git-based collaboration, and operates entirely offline to ensure data privacy.

repos.description: Beautiful, Modern & Opinionated Linux
repos.summary_zh: Omarchy 是 DHH 出品的现代 Opinionated Linux 发行版，以美观界面、内置 AI 智能体能力、Neovim 与终端工作流为核心亮点。提供完善的一键配置、主题系统、dotfiles 管理与跨平台适配，面向追求高效开发体验的工程师群体。
repos.summary_en: Omarchy is a beautiful, opinionated Linux distro by DHH featuring built-in AI agent capabilities, Neovim-centric workflows, and a polished terminal environment. It offers one-click configuration, theming, dotfiles management, and cross-platform support for developers seeking a productivity-optimized OS.

repos.description: the runtime your coding agents live on
repos.summary_zh: Herdr 是一个基于 Rust 构建的终端 AI 智能体运行时，支持多任务并行、会话持久化及跨设备重新连接。它提供原生终端视图与 Socket API，允许智能体间协作，并通过插件扩展工作流，专为开发者打造高效自动化环境。
repos.summary_en: Herdr is a Rust-based terminal runtime for AI agents, supporting multi-tasking, session persistence, and reattachment across devices. It offers native terminal views and a Socket API for agent collaboration, extensible via plugins, designed to build efficient automation environments for developers.

repos.description: Open-source Rust agent engine and terminal client for Codewhale, with provider choice, tools, approvals and receipts.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale是开源终端编程智能体，用Rust构建，支持任意AI模型。它能读取项目、编辑文件、运行命令并验证结果，适用于自动化代码修复、测试调试与本地开发工作流，提供TUI交互与headless模式。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source coding agent for the terminal, built in Rust and compatible with any AI model. It reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and verifies its own work, suitable for automated code fixes, test debugging, and local development workflows, with TUI and headless modes.

repos.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板通过Claude Code实现网页逆向工程，利用Chrome MCP自动提取设计元素与组件规格，并行构建像素级复刻站点。支持多页面、响应式交互还原及资产下载，基于Next.js 16+shadcn/ui技术栈，提供自动化开发流水线。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered website cloning template that reverse-engineers any site using Claude Code and Chrome MCP. It extracts design tokens, generates component specs, and rebuilds pages pixel-perfect via parallel builder agents in isolated git worktrees. Built with Next.js 16, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS v4.

repos.description: A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.
repos.summary_zh: Reasonix 是一款专为终端设计的 DeepSeek 原生 AI 编程智能体，基于前缀缓存稳定性优化，支持长时间运行且保持低 token 成本。其核心优势在于高达 99.82% 的缓存命中率，显著降低推理开销，适用于持续编码任务。
repos.summary_en: Reasonix is a DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for the terminal, engineered for prefix-cache stability to minimize token costs during long sessions. It achieves up to 99.82% cache hit rate, drastically reducing inference expenses while enabling persistent, efficient development workflows.

repos.description: Maple Mono: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font icons for IDE and terminal, fine-grained customization options. 带连字和控制台图标的圆角等宽字体，中英文宽度完美2:1，细粒度的自定义选项
repos.summary_zh: Maple Mono 是一款专为提升编码体验而设计的开源等宽字体，具有圆角设计、连字功能及 Nerd-Font 图标支持，适用于 IDE 和终端环境。其特色包括可变字重、智能连字、中英文 2:1 完美对齐，以及细粒度自定义选项，支持简繁中文和日文，适合多语言开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Maple Mono is an open-source monospace font designed to enhance coding flow, featuring rounded corners, ligatures, and Nerd-Font icons for IDEs and terminals. It offers variable font weights, smart ligatures, perfect 2:1 Chinese-English alignment, and extensive customization, supporting Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese for multilingual development environments.

repos.summary_zh: Void 是一款开源的 Cursor 替代 IDE，支持在代码库中使用 AI 智能体、可视化变更与检查点，并允许本地部署任意模型。其核心优势在于直接与 AI 服务商通信而不保留用户数据，基于 VSCode 深度定制，提供高度可定制的 AI 编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Void is an open-source alternative to Cursor, enabling AI agents to work on your codebase with checkpointing, change visualization, and local model hosting. It communicates directly with AI providers without storing your data, built as a VSCode fork with a focus on innovation over feature parity.

repos.description: Resume template for Chinese programmers . 程序员简历模板系列。包括PHP程序员简历模板、iOS程序员简历模板、Android程序员简历模板、Web前端程序员简历模板、Java程序员简历模板、C/C++程序员简历模板、NodeJS程序员简历模板、架构师简历模板以及通用程序员简历模板
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供涵盖PHP、iOS、Android、Web前端、Java、C/C++、NodeJS、架构师等9类程序员岗位的中文简历模板，支持Markdown格式，由AI职业顾问职小兔®优化设计。配套提供在线简历工具冷熊简历与自建版DeerResume，并附《如何写好技术简历》教学资源，助力程序员高效打造专业简历。
repos.summary_en: This repo offers 9 resume templates for Chinese programmers, covering PHP, iOS, Android, Web Frontend, Java, C/C++, NodeJS, and Architect roles in Markdown format, optimized by AI career advisor 职小兔®. It includes tools like Cold Bear Resume and DeerResume, plus teaching resources on writing effective tech resumes to help developers build professional profiles.

repos.description: 互联网首份程序员考公指南，由3位已经进入体制内的前大厂程序员联合献上。
repos.summary_zh: 《程序员考公指南》由三位成功上岸的前大厂程序员联合撰写，总结一年在职备考经验，提供从备考策略、时间管理到岗位选择的系统性指导，帮助程序员转型进入体制内，涵盖公务员、事业编制及教师岗位，强调实用性与可行性。
repos.summary_en: The 'Programmer's Guide to Civil Service Exams' is co-authored by three former tech employees who successfully transitioned into government roles after a year of part-time preparation. It offers practical strategies for programmers considering public sector careers, covering civil service, public institutions, and teaching positions with real-world insights and actionable advice.

repos.description: The Developer Tool for Designers • An Open-Source AI-First Design tool • Visually build, style, and edit your code with AI • World's best, top-most agent recommended #1 Developer tool for Designers to design with Real Code.
repos.summary_zh: Onlook 是一款面向设计师的开源 AI 驱动可视化代码编辑器，支持在浏览器中实时编辑 React 应用。它结合 Next.js 和 TailwindCSS，提供类 Figma 的 UI 设计体验，实现视觉化开发、实时预览、组件管理和一键部署，是 Bolt.new 等工具的替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Onlook is an open-source, AI-first visual code editor for designers, enabling real-time React app editing in the browser. Built with Next.js and TailwindCSS, it offers a Figma-like interface for visual development, component management, and instant deployment, serving as an alternative to tools like Bolt.new.

repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是一款基于 AI 智能体的逆向工程工具，支持从应用程序行为到原生二进制的全栈代码审查。它通过 MCP 协议无缝集成 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 AI 助手，可静态分析 JavaScript、.NET 及动态分析二进制文件，支持 Hopper/Ghidra 引擎，帮助开发者深入理解软件实现机制并快速复用功能。
repos.summary_en: REA is an AI agent-driven reverse engineering tool for full-stack code inspection from app behavior to native binaries. It integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI assistants via MCP protocol, supporting static analysis of JavaScript, .NET assemblies, and dynamic binary analysis with Hopper/Ghidra engines. Developers can inspect undocumented apps, understand implementation details, and rebuild features for their own projects.

repos.description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
repos.summary_zh: Roo Code 是一款 VS Code 扩展，将 AI 智能体团队集成到代码编辑器中，支持自然语言生成代码、多模式协作（编码/架构/调试/问答）、自动化任务处理及文档维护，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Roo Code is a VS Code extension that embeds an AI-powered development team directly into your editor. It enables natural language code generation, multi-mode workflows (coding, architecture, debugging, Q&A), automation, and documentation, dramatically boosting developer productivity.

repos.description: flutter 开发者帮助 APP，包含 flutter 常用 140+ 组件的demo 演示与中文文档
repos.summary_zh: FlutterGo 是阿里巴巴推出的 Flutter 开发者辅助应用，提供 140+ 组件的中文文档与演示，帮助开发者快速掌握 Flutter 开发。因团队调整暂停维护，但计划未来迭代并招募社区贡献者。
repos.summary_en: FlutterGo is an Alibaba-developed Flutter developer helper app featuring 140+ component demos and Chinese documentation. It aids developers in mastering Flutter. Due to internal restructuring, maintenance is temporarily paused, with plans for future updates and community contributions.

repos.summary_zh: Vibe Coding 指南是一个通过 AI 结对编程实现创意快速落地的开源项目，提供多语言支持与完整工具链，涵盖提示工程、开发流程优化及自动化部署，助力开发者高效构建原型与产品。
repos.summary_en: The Vibe Coding Guide is an open-source project enabling rapid idea-to-prototype development through AI pair programming, featuring multilingual support, prompt engineering frameworks, and automated workflows for efficient software creation.

repos.description: An open-source, AI-integrated, cross-platform terminal for seamless workflows
repos.summary_zh: Wave Terminal 是一款开源、集成 AI 的智能跨平台终端，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它兼容任意 AI 模型（如 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini），支持本地运行 Ollama 等模型，无需账户即可使用。核心特性包括：持久化 SSH 会话、内嵌远程文件编辑器、富文本预览（Markdown/图片/PDF）、AI 助手实时分析终端输出并操作文件，以及强大的 `wsh` CLI 工具实现工作区管理与跨会话数据同步。
repos.summary_en: Wave Terminal is an open-source, AI-integrated terminal for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It supports any AI model via BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or local models like Ollama/LM Studio. Key features include durable SSH sessions with auto-reconnect, built-in remote file editor, rich file previews (markdown, images, PDFs), context-aware Wave AI assistant that analyzes terminal output and performs file operations, and a powerful `wsh` CLI system for workspace management and cross-session data sync.

repos.description: agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: herdr 是一款运行在终端中的智能体多路复用器，支持工作区、标签页和窗格管理，提供鼠标交互、拖拽分割、实时状态查看（阻塞/工作中/完成）等功能。无需 GUI 应用，直接显示智能体原生终端输出，支持断开后重连且智能体持续运行。适用于 Linux 和 macOS 系统，可通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装。
repos.summary_en: herdr is a terminal-based agent multiplexer that supports workspaces, tabs, and panes with mouse-native interactions like click, drag, and split. It displays real-time agent states (blocked, working, done) and shows the agent's native terminal output. Agents keep running after detach and can be reattached later. No GUI or Electron wrapper—works on Linux and macOS, installable via Homebrew or script.

repos.description: 数字生命卡兹克开源的 AI Skills 合集 | Agent Skills: leader（帮你定义目标）, neat-freak 洁癖, hv-analysis, khazix-writer & more — Claude Code, Codex & 40+ agents
repos.summary_zh: Khazix Skills 是一个开源的 AI 技能合集，包含多个可直接集成到 Claude Code、Codex 等智能体平台的结构化指令（Skills）和通用提示词（Prompts）。核心功能包括自动同步项目文档与记忆（neat-freak）、深度行业分析生成万字 PDF 报告（hv-analysis）以及个性化写作风格迁移（khazix-writer），旨在提升 AI 协作效率与输出一致性。
repos.summary_en: Khazix Skills is an open-source collection of AI skills and prompts designed for integration with agent platforms like Claude Code and Codex. It includes tools for auto-syncing project docs and agent memory (neat-freak), generating in-depth analytical reports via horizontal-vertical analysis (hv-analysis), and mimicking a personal writing style (khazix-writer), enhancing AI consistency and productivity.

repos.description: Orchestrate multiple coding agents from desktop and mobile
repos.summary_zh: Paseo 是一个跨平台编程代理编排工具，支持通过手机、桌面端和 CLI 远程管理 Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 等 AI 编码助手。核心特性包括本地自托管运行、多模型统一接口、语音控制、跨设备同步以及零追踪的隐私保护。用户可在任意终端启动任务，实现从构思到部署的无缝协作。
repos.summary_en: Paseo is a cross-platform orchestration tool for coding agents, enabling remote management of Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode via phone, desktop, or CLI. Key features include self-hosted local execution, unified multi-provider interface, voice control, device synchronization, and privacy-first design with no telemetry. It allows seamless task delegation and hands-off automation across environments.

repos.description: Visualize any GitHub codebase: free interactive architecture diagrams and one-minute explainer videos. Replace 'hub' with 'diagram' in any GitHub URL.
repos.summary_zh: GitDiagram 是一款免费的交互式 GitHub 仓库可视化工具，可将任意仓库结构秒级转换为系统架构图。支持点击组件跳转源码、导出 Mermaid 代码或 PNG 图片，集成 OpenAI GPT-5.2 实现智能分析，提供私有仓库支持与自托管部署方案，适用于快速理解复杂代码库。
repos.summary_en: GitDiagram is a free, fast tool that converts any GitHub repository into interactive architecture diagrams in seconds. It leverages OpenAI GPT-5.2 for intelligent analysis, supports clickable navigation to source files, exports Mermaid/PNG formats, and offers private repo support with self-hosting capabilities for deep codebase understanding.

repos.description: 经典编程书籍大全，涵盖：计算机系统与网络、系统架构、算法与数据结构、前端开发、后端开发、移动开发、数据库、测试、项目与团队、程序员职业修炼、求职面试等
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收录100+经典编程书籍，全面覆盖计算机系统与网络、算法与数据结构、前后端开发、数据库、测试、职业修炼等核心领域，精选伯乐在线及社区广泛推荐的权威技术读物，是程序员系统提升技能的理想资源库。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 100+ essential programming books across core domains including computer systems, algorithms, web/mobile development, databases, testing, and career growth. It aggregates highly recommended technical reads from Jobbole and the developer community, serving as a comprehensive learning resource for programmers.

repos.description: Superset is an agentic IDE to orchestrate 100+ coding agents in parallel. Run any agent with your own subscription.
repos.summary_zh: Superset 是专为 AI 智能体时代设计的代码编辑器，支持在本地并行运行多个 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 编码代理。通过 Git 工作树隔离任务、内置终端与差异查看器，实现零切换成本的高效开发流程，显著提升编码效率。
repos.summary_en: Superset is an IDE designed for the AI Agents Era, enabling parallel execution of multiple CLI-based coding agents like Claude Code and Codex on your machine. It isolates tasks via Git worktrees, provides built-in terminal and diff viewer, and eliminates context-switching overhead to boost development efficiency.

repos.description: A faster, simpler way to drive browsers supporting the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
repos.summary_zh: chromedp 是一个高效的 Go 语言库，用于通过 Chrome DevTools 协议驱动浏览器，无需外部依赖。它支持无头模式运行、页面截图、自动化操作等场景，适用于网页爬虫、自动化测试和数据采集。核心优势包括高性能、简洁 API 和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: chromedp is a high-performance Go library for driving browsers via the Chrome DevTools Protocol without external dependencies. It supports headless browsing, page screenshots, and automation tasks like web scraping and testing. Key features include fast execution, simple API, and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: :octocat: A collection of APIs
repos.summary_zh: Awesome APIs 是一个精选的 API 集合库，涵盖动漫、博客、书籍、商业、日历、云服务等 40+ 领域，为开发者提供丰富的第三方接口资源，支持快速集成各类功能，提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Awesome APIs is a curated collection of over 40 categories of developer-friendly APIs, including anime, blogging, books, business, cloud services, and more, enabling rapid integration of diverse functionalities and enhancing development efficiency.

repos.description: 超级速查表 - 编程语言、框架和开发工具的速查表，单个文件包含一切你需要知道的东西 :zap:
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是专为开发者设计的中文速查表集合，涵盖编程语言（如 Bash、Python、Go、JavaScript）、开发工具（如 Git、Gdb、Tmux）和文本编辑器（如 Vim、Emacs）的核心语法与命令，每个速查表均为单个文件，便于快速查阅，解决日常开发中频繁查阅文档的问题。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a curated collection of Chinese cheatsheets for developers, covering programming languages (Bash, Python, Go, JavaScript), development tools (Git, Gdb, Tmux), and text editors (Vim, Emacs). Each cheatsheet is a single-file reference for quick lookup, eliminating the need to search scattered documentation.

repos.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
repos.summary_zh: Worktrunk 是一个专为并行 AI 智能体工作流设计的 Git worktree 管理 CLI 工具，通过简化 worktree 操作使其像分支一样易用。支持自动化钩子、快速扩展多代理协作，显著提升开发效率与工作流自动化水平。
repos.summary_en: Worktrunk is a CLI tool for managing Git worktrees, optimized for parallel AI agent workflows. It simplifies worktree operations to be as easy as branches, with automation hooks and scalable multi-agent support for enhanced developer productivity.

repos.description: 收集整理Android开发所需的Android SDK、开发中用到的工具、Android开发教程、Android设计规范，免费的设计素材等。
repos.summary_zh: AndroidDevTools 是一个专注于 Android 开发的一站式资源平台，提供 Android SDK、开发工具、设计规范、教程及素材的整合。涵盖从开发环境搭建、代码生成、资源处理到设计协作的全流程工具链，支持 Android Studio、Gradle 等主流技术栈，助力开发者高效构建高质量应用。
repos.summary_en: AndroidDevTools is a comprehensive platform for Android developers, offering curated resources including Android SDK, development tools, design guidelines, tutorials, and free assets. It covers the full development lifecycle—from environment setup and code generation to resource optimization and UI design—supporting major tools like Android Studio and Gradle to enhance productivity.

repos.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 是一款轻量跨平台本地网关工具，统一管理多种 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等）的模型选择与 API 路由。通过菜单栏应用、TUI 和 CLI 三种形态，无缝切换模型、共享订阅、自动同步实时模型目录，并精确编辑配置文件，实现多代理一站式编排。
repos.summary_en: Magpie is a lightweight cross-platform local gateway that centrally manages model selection and API routing for multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.). It offers menu-bar GUI, TUI and CLI interfaces, supports shared subscriptions, real-time model discovery, and surgical config editing for unified multi-agent orchestration.

repos.description: 【🔞🔞🔞 内含不适合未成年人阅读的图片】基于我擅长的编程、绘画、写作展开的 AI 探索和总结：StableDiffusion 是一种强大的图像生成模型，能够通过对一张图片进行演化来生成新的图片。ChatGPT 是一个基于 Transformer 的语言生成模型，它能够自动为输入的主题生成合适的文章。而 Github Copilot 是一个智能编程助手，能够加速日常编程活动。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目深入探索了基于编程、绘画与写作的AI应用，涵盖StableDiffusion图像生成、ChatGPT文本创作及GitHub Copilot代码辅助。通过Prompt工程实践，系统解析了AI模型在图像描述、文章构思与代码生成中的交互逻辑，并提出了'Prompt编程'概念，探讨自然语言驱动软件开发的可能性。
repos.summary_en: This project explores AI applications in programming, painting, and writing through StableDiffusion image generation, ChatGPT text creation, and GitHub Copilot code assistance. It systematically analyzes how AI models interact with human input via prompt engineering for image description, article structuring, and code generation, proposing the concept of 'prompt programming' as a bridge between natural language and software development.

repos.description: The go-to web for your AI coding agent — local-first search, fetch, crawl & research over MCP. No API keys, no cloud, $0/query. Public beta.
repos.summary_zh: wigolo 是一款本地优先的 AI 智能体网页情报 MCP 服务器，为 AI 编程助手提供搜索、抓取、爬取及自主研究能力。它完全运行于本地（~/.wigolo/），无需 API 密钥或云服务，实现零成本查询，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流工具，是 AI 时代替代传统付费搜索 API 的隐私保护方案。
repos.summary_en: wigolo is a local-first MCP server delivering web intelligence for AI coding agents. It provides search, fetch, crawl, and autonomous research capabilities entirely on-device without API keys or cloud services. Supporting Claude Code, Cursor, and other major tools, it offers a privacy-focused, zero-cost alternative to metered search APIs.

repos.description: 【编程随想】收藏的开源项目清单
repos.summary_zh: 编程随想维护的开源项目收藏清单，涵盖C/C++和Python两大语言的技术库与示例代码，聚焦程序员实用工具与学习资源，便于快速检索与参考。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of open-source projects by Programthink, featuring code libraries and examples in C/C++ and Python, designed for developers to quickly access practical tools and learning resources.

repos.description: Python QR Code image generator
repos.summary_zh: 纯 Python 编写的 QR 码生成库，支持生成 PNG、SVG 等格式图像，提供命令行工具和 Python API。可自定义尺寸、颜色、纠错等级等参数，适用于快速生成二维码并集成到自动化流程中。
repos.summary_en: A pure Python library for generating QR codes, supporting PNG, SVG, and console output. Offers command-line interface and Python API with customizable parameters like size, colors, and error correction levels, ideal for automation and integration.

repos.description: README file generator, powered by AI.
repos.summary_zh: ReadmeAI 是一款基于 AI 的 README 文件自动生成工具，支持通过代码仓库 URL 或本地路径一键生成结构化、详细的文档。支持 OpenAI、Ollama、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种 LLM 模型，具备智能文件过滤、离线模式运行、高度可定制化模板与样式等功能，旨在提升开发者文档编写效率。
repos.summary_en: ReadmeAI is an AI-powered tool that automatically generates high-quality README files from code repositories. It supports multiple LLM backends (OpenAI, Ollama, Anthropic, Gemini), offers customizable templates, intelligent file filtering via .readmeaiignore, and works offline. Designed to boost developer productivity and ensure consistent documentation across projects.

repos.description: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
repos.summary_zh: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
repos.summary_en: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

repos.description: A dev environment for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Jean 是一款基于 Tauri v2 的桌面 AI 助手应用，专为多项目管理、git worktree 自动化及 Claude/Codex/OpenCode CLI 集成设计。支持会话管理、AI 编程助手（含思维链与 MCP 支持）、GitHub 问题追踪、终端集成及远程 Web 访问，提供本地化的无厂商锁定开发体验。
repos.summary_en: Jean is a desktop AI assistant built with Tauri v2, designed for managing multiple projects, git worktrees, and integrating Claude CLI, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. It offers session management, AI-powered development workflows (with thinking modes and MCP support), GitHub integration, terminal access, and remote web access—all running locally without vendor lock-in.

repos.description: AndroidCat安卓书签导航集合
repos.summary_zh: AndroidCat 是一个专为 Android 开发者打造的网址导航集合，涵盖资源文档、技术社区、教程、开源项目等八大类别，提供官方文档、设计指南、开发框架、技术资讯等一站式学习资源，助力开发者高效获取 Android 开发所需工具和知识。
repos.summary_en: AndroidCat is a curated collection of Android development resources, serving as a comprehensive navigation hub for developers. It aggregates official documentation, design guidelines, frameworks, tutorials, open-source projects, and tech communities across eight categories, enabling efficient access to essential tools and knowledge for Android development.

repos.description: Spec-driven development workflow for AI coding agents: architecture-first planning, task decomposition, GitHub Issue/PR tracking, Deep Discuss, and adaptive control for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other Markdown-capable agents.
repos.summary_zh: Spec-Driven Develop 是一个平台无关的 AI 代理技能，通过单个 `SKILL.md` 文件为大规模复杂任务提供全流程预开发自动化。它不依赖框架或运行时，而是以纯 Markdown 结构化指令驱动代理完成项目分析、任务拆解、进度跟踪和迭代开发，实现轻量级但高度可控的开发方法论。
repos.summary_en: Spec-Driven Develop is a platform-agnostic AI agent skill that automates pre-development workflows via a single SKILL.md file. It enables any coding agent to execute structured methodologies—including project analysis, task decomposition, and progress tracking—without frameworks or runtime dependencies, offering lightweight yet powerful automation for complex tasks.

repos.description: QuietHarness：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 共用的轻量 AI 工作系统
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个经过实战检验的 Claude Code 工作流模板，提供内存管理、上下文工程和任务路由三大核心能力。基于3个月多项目日常使用经验构建，采用三层架构设计：常驻规则层、按需文档层和热数据工作区，实现智能持久化开发伙伴。支持多模型分级路由、自动保存进度、强制验证完成状态，显著提升开发效率与代码质量。
repos.summary_en: A battle-tested Claude Code workflow template featuring memory management, context engineering, and task routing from 3 months of daily usage. Implements a three-layer architecture: always-loaded rules, on-demand docs, and hot working memory. Enables persistent, self-improving development with multi-model routing, auto-save, verification gates, and cross-session task tracking for production-ready workflows.

repos.description: A minimal modern terminal for AI coding experience — Sidebar workspaces; horizontal / vertical split panes; one-click agent launch; per-agent activity readout; live workspace state with one-click Node and branch switching.
repos.summary_zh: kooky 是一款专为 AI 编码打造的现代化 macOS 终端模拟器，基于 libghostty 实现 GPU 渲染。核心特性包括侧边栏工作区、多窗格分屏、一键启动 Claude Code/Gemini CLI 等多种 AI Agent、Git Worktree 隔离开发、右键选中内容直接询问 Agent、模糊快速打开面板以及多行提示词编辑器。支持会话自动恢复、跨窗口拖拽标签页，无账号无遥测，状态完全本地存储。
repos.summary_en: kooky is a minimal modern terminal emulator built for AI coding on macOS, powered by libghostty with GPU rendering. Key features include sidebar workspaces, horizontal/vertical split panes, one-click launch of Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other AI agents, Git Worktree isolation, right-click-to-ask-agent on selections, fuzzy Quick Open panel, and a multi-line prompt composer. Sessions auto-resume across restarts, tabs are draggable across panes and windows, and all state stays local with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.description: Agent skill that draws architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as hand-placed SVG, to one linted house style.
repos.summary_zh: SVG 手绘风格架构图绘制技能，为 AI 编码代理提供统一的布局算术、颜色系统与零依赖校验器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 40+ 代理，确保生成的序列图、数据流图、生命周期图经 svg-lint 12 项检查后保持 house 样式一致。
repos.summary_en: An agent skill that draws hand-crafted SVG diagrams — architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle — following a unified house style with layout arithmetic, a color system, and a zero-dependency linter (svg-lint) with 12 checks. Works with 40+ AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

repos.description: django-debug-toolbar in WebKit DevTools. Works fine with background Ajax requests and non-HTML responses.
repos.summary_zh: Django Debug Panel 将 Django Debug Toolbar 集成至 WebKit DevTools，支持 AJAX 请求和 HTML 响应外的调试场景，专为单页应用和 AJAX 密集型项目设计，提供浏览器内实时调试能力。
repos.summary_en: Django Debug Panel embeds the Django Debug Toolbar into WebKit DevTools, enabling debugging for AJAX requests and non-HTML responses. Ideal for single-page and AJAX-heavy applications, it offers in-browser real-time debugging.

repos.description: A tiny macOS menu bar app that tracks your dev servers across projects.
repos.summary_zh: Port Menu 是一款轻量级 macOS 菜单栏应用，专为开发者设计，用于自动追踪跨项目的本地开发服务器。它能实时扫描并展示 Git 仓库名、分支、端口及运行时长，支持一键打开浏览器、复制 URL 或终止进程，无需任何配置即可实现 localhost 服务的可视化管理。
repos.summary_en: Port Menu is a lightweight macOS menu bar app designed for developers to automatically track local development servers across projects. It scans running processes to display Git repo names, branches, ports, and uptime. With zero configuration, it enables one-click access to open in browser, copy URLs, or kill processes directly from the menu bar.

repos.summary_zh: EdgeMirror 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 和 Vercel Functions 构建的 CDN 式边缘镜像网关。它通过单一域名路径路由，为 PyPI、PyTorch、Hugging Face、GitHub、Docker 及 Linux 镜像等主流开发者资源提供统一的加速代理，有效解决网络访问受限或速度慢的问题。
repos.summary_en: EdgeMirror is a CDN-style edge mirror gateway built on Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Functions. It provides unified acceleration for major developer resources like PyPI, PyTorch, Hugging Face, GitHub, Docker, and Linux mirrors via single-domain path routing, solving network access and speed issues.

repos.description: Agent Skills for theming AI desktop apps: reference image → reversible Codex/WorkBuddy skin → verify, repair, publish. | 给 AI 桌面应用换肤的 Agent Skills：参考图 → 可逆皮肤 → 验证、修复、发布。
repos.summary_zh: CodeDrobe Skills 是一个开源的 AI 桌面应用主题生成与管理系统，专为 OpenAI Codex 和腾讯 WorkBuddy 等基于 Chromium/Electron 的 AI 桌面端提供可逆的主题定制方案。它通过 AI 技能（Skill）驱动，支持 DOM 快照分析、语义化主题生成与跨平台应用，极大简化了 AI 桌面环境的个性化与视觉管理。
repos.summary_en: CodeDrobe Skills is an open-source AI-driven theming engine for Chromium/Electron-based AI desktop apps like OpenAI Codex and Tencent WorkBuddy. It provides a reversible theme customization workflow utilizing DOM snapshot analysis and semantic generation. Managed via installable Agent Skills, it simplifies visual personalization and cross-platform theme deployment for AI desktop environments.

repos.description: Git worktree-based task manager with integrated terminals for CLI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Ouijit 是一款基于 Git worktree 的 AI 编程代理任务管理器，集成终端会话、生命周期钩子与脚本系统，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等代理工具。提供看板式任务管理、自动并行工作流、实时代理状态通知、VM 沙箱隔离及会话恢复等功能，无需账号、无遥测，专为 AI 辅助开发流程打造。
repos.summary_en: Ouijit is a Git worktree-based task and terminal session manager designed for AI coding agents. It integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and other agent CLIs via lifecycle hooks, scripts, and a session-aware CLI. Features include kanban task management, automatic parallel workstreams, live agent status with notifications, VM sandboxing for untrusted code, and session resumption—fully open-source with no accounts or telemetry.
